topStories.headline: Fed Holds Rates 9-3 as Three Officials Dissent in Favor of a Hike
topStories.summary: The FOMC voted 9-3 to hold the fed funds rate at 3.5%–3.75% for a fifth consecutive meeting, with Cleveland's Hammack, Minneapolis's Kashkari, and Dallas's Logan dissenting for a 25bp hike — the most dissents since September 2016.
topStories.marketImpact: Dow ↓ 1,153 pts (-2.19%), S&P 500 ↓ 1.52%, Nasdaq ↓ 1.74%; bond market signalled the Fed is falling behind on inflation; September hike bets re-priced higher

topStories.headline: 30-Year Treasury Yield Tops 5.2%, Highest Since 2007, After Fed Stands Pat
topStories.summary: The 30-year Treasury yield surged to 5.244% and the 10-year jumped 7bps to 4.67% as bond markets re-priced the risk that the Fed is behind the curve on inflation following its hawkish hold.
topStories.marketImpact: TLT ↓; rate-sensitive equities (real estate, utilities) ↓; dollar ↑ on hawkish repricing; 30Y highest level since July 2007

topStories.headline: Meta Q2 Free Cash Flow Collapses 91% as AI Capital Expenditure Hits $31 Billion
topStories.summary: Meta's Q2 revenue grew 28% to $60.8B, but free cash flow fell 91% to just $784M as AI infrastructure capex doubled to $31.1B in a single quarter; the company projects full-year 2026 capex of $130–145B.
topStories.marketImpact: META ↓ ~5% after-hours; questions over AI capex sustainability and return timelines weigh on broader mega-cap tech sentiment

topStories.headline: Iran Fires Ballistic Missiles at US Forces; All Intercepted; Trump Threatens to Hit Iran Hard
topStories.summary: Iran's IRGC launched a surprise ballistic missile attack targeting US troops in the Middle East; all were intercepted by US defenses, but President Trump's threat to retaliate drove a sharp move in oil markets.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent crude ↑ above $90; WTI ↑ 6.6% to $84.46; energy stocks ↑; gold ↑ on safe-haven demand

topStories.headline: Kioxia Plunges 16%, Nikkei Falls 930 Points as AI Chip Sell-Off Deepens
topStories.summary: Japanese memory chip giant Kioxia Holdings fell another 16%, halving its market cap from peak as investors unwound leveraged AI chip positions; the Nikkei 225 fell 930 points and SoftBank dropped 7%.
topStories.marketImpact: 285A.T ↓ 16%; 9984.T ↓ 7%; Nikkei ↓ 1.49% to 61,434; PHLX Semiconductor Index ↓ 4.5%; MU, AMD, NVDA all under pressure

topStories.headline: Microsoft Azure Crosses $100B Revenue as Cloud Posts Fastest Growth in Four Years
topStories.summary: Microsoft's Q2 FY2026 results showed total revenue of $90B (+18%), with Azure up 39% YoY crossing $100B for the first time and commercial remaining backlog more than doubling to $625B.
topStories.marketImpact: MSFT ↑ slightly; a positive counterweight to Meta's FCF miss; validates AI infrastructure investment thesis for cloud providers

topStories.headline: Zhongji Innolight Debuts on HKEX in Asia's Second-Largest IPO of 2026
topStories.summary: Optical module maker Zhongji Innolight (3308.HK) begins trading on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange today after raising HK$53.4B ($6.81B) — the biggest HK listing since Alibaba's 2019 secondary IPO — with Q1 net profit up 262% YoY.
topStories.marketImpact: 3308.HK watch on debut; Hang Seng edged up 0.4% yesterday, bucking regional selloff; sustained institutional appetite for AI supply chain plays in HK

topStories.headline: Advantest Delivers Strong Quarterly Earnings on Robust AI Chip-Tester Demand
topStories.summary: Chip-test equipment maker Advantest reported $1.51 EPS for the latest quarter with FY2026 guidance of 1.42T yen in net sales, as AI semiconductor production sustains robust demand for its testing systems.
topStories.marketImpact: 6857.T watch on open; strong guidance could help stabilise Japan's battered semiconductor complex; positive read-through for AI chip supply chain health

topStories.headline: Bank of England Super Thursday: Hold Expected at 3.75% but Services Inflation Keeps Hike Risk Live
topStories.summary: The BoE announces its rate decision today at 12:00pm London / 7:00am ET with consensus expecting a hold at 3.75%; the June vote was 7-2 with Greene and Pill dissenting for a hike, and renewed oil price spikes add upside risk.
topStories.marketImpact: GBP/USD watch; hawkish surprise or shift in vote split could ripple into global rate expectations already strained by the Fed's three dissenters

topStories.headline: Apple Reports Q3 Results Tonight — Tim Cook's Final Earnings Call as CEO
topStories.summary: Apple releases Q3 fiscal 2026 results after the bell today with analysts expecting EPS of $1.89 (+20% YoY) on ~$109B revenue, driven by iPhone demand and Services strength; John Ternus succeeds Tim Cook as CEO.
topStories.marketImpact: AAPL watch after close; any Services deceleration or weaker iPhone guidance would compound yesterday's market pain; strong beat could anchor sentiment
